prompt:
Bug report: cooking bechamel today took the new milk (lot HD-1026) although lot HD-1022 expires tomorrow. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Fixed: stock was being taken from the most recently received batch; it is now taken first-expired-first (no-expiry batches last, then first received, then lower id), so lot HD-1022 is used before HD-1026. Added two regression tests in tests/stock.test.js (the milk case and the tie-break order) and a changelog bullet; `npm test` and `npm run lint` pass. The fix does not skip batches that are already past their expiry date — they are still used first.
